text: Hello boys and girls, welcome back to Sophie's class.Hope you can enjoy it.Today we will go through the text in detail and know more about how the authors introduce memory.Besides, we will try to figure out what a good feature article is.Please get your student's book and worksheet ready.Let's begin today's lesson.In the last period, you were given homework.List two more ways to improve our memory.Now, Tom would like to share his work with us.I made a mind map to help ourselves remember something.For example, last year, after reading an introduction about Beijing, I made a mind map like this to help myself remember its population, area, location, and famous tourist attractions.I think making a mind map is very helpful, and it allows me to use both sides of my brain at the same time.Let's listen to the second way Tom introduced.A very small living thing.Microscope, which refers to an instrument used to make very small things look larger, and Microlite, which is a very small aircraft for one or two people.Then let's have a quick review.Please use the words and phrases from the text to complete the passage below.Take out your worksheet and finish task one.Let's check the answers.When we are young, both our long-term memory and short-term memory are good.However, when we injure our brains, our memory may become weaker.If we want to improve our memory, I think one basic way, the link method can help us.We will remember a new word easily if there is a silly, strange, and colorful picture in our mind.Meanwhile, when we meet with something dramatic, we can remember it well, too.In a word, memory is essential for our life.Have you got all the answers?In the last period, we learned that all these five articles are feature articles, which focus on memory.This time, please read the text and tell the structure of a feature article.Please read the text and tell the structure of a feature article.Please read the text and tell the structure of a feature articlePlease read the text and tell the structure of a feature article.Please read the text and tell the structure of a feature articleIn a feature article, we can find a topic sentence at the beginning.It can be a fact.For example, memory is connected with our feelings.It can also be an opinion.For example, memory is essential for life.After that, there are supporting details, which are used to support the main idea.When giving supporting details, five authors use some explanatory methods to make the readers understand their articles better.What explanatory methods do you know?Giving examples, just like this.Listing figures, look at this one.Giving definitions, just like this.The writer uses this to tell us what decaffeinated tea is.Classification, 分类.Many dinosaurs were harmless.Others were harmful.Comparison and contrast, 做对比.Here's an example of it.Let's move on to see what methods these authors used.First, please read author's article and find out the methods he used.Have you finished?Here, when people get old, their short-term memory becomes weaker, but they can still remember things that happened a long time ago.Author used the method comparison and contrast.Why did he contrast short-term memory with long-term memory?Great, in order to introduce the feature of two kinds of memory.From this sentence, we can clearly understand the difference between short-term memory and long-term memory.And he also used the method giving examples.What's the purpose of it?Right.He took a joke as an example to imply that when people get old, their short-term memory becomes weaker.Now, it's your time to find out methods the other authors used and tell the purpose of using them.Please read the other articles and complete the table.Take out your worksheet and finish task
